CONFIG:
# Interactive zsh only. Tool installers run separately, never at startup.
[[ -o interactive ]] || return

# zsh's tied arrays keep PATH and FPATH unique, including after re-sourcing.
typeset -gU path fpath
export BUN_INSTALL="${BUN_INSTALL:-$HOME/.bun}"
export PNPM_HOME="${PNPM_HOME:-${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/Library}/pnpm}"
export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"
path=(
  "$HOME/.local/bin" "$BUN_INSTALL/bin" "$HOME/.deno/bin"
  "$PNPM_HOME/bin" "$PNPM_HOME" "$HOME/.opencode/bin"
  "$HOME/.atuin/bin" "$HOME/.cargo/bin" /usr/local/go/bin
  $path
)
export PATH

# Register completion directories BEFORE compinit, with no tool subprocesses.
() {
  local dir
  for dir in "$HOME/.zsh/completions" "$BUN_INSTALL" \
             /opt/homebrew/share/zsh/site-functions /usr/local/share/zsh/site-functions; do
    [[ -d "$dir" ]] && fpath=("$dir" $fpath)
  done
  return 0
}

# NVM's Bash completion adapter is also deferred until completions are needed.
_reset1_nvm_completions() {
  if (( ${_reset1_nvm_loaded:-0} && $+functions[compdef] && ! ${_reset1_nvm_completion_loaded:-0} )) \
     && [[ -s "$NVM_DIR/bash_completion" ]]; then
    autoload -Uz bashcompinit
    bashcompinit
    source "$NVM_DIR/bash_completion"
    typeset -g _reset1_nvm_completion_loaded=1
  fi
  return 0
}

# First Tab initializes normal cached completions. Frameworks that already
# provide compdef keep their completion system and key bindings.
reset1-completions() {
  if (( ! $+functions[compdef] )); then
    autoload -Uz compinit
    compinit -i -d "${ZDOTDIR:-$HOME}/.zcompdump-reset1" || return
    bindkey -M emacs '^I' expand-or-complete
    bindkey -M viins '^I' expand-or-complete
  fi
  _reset1_nvm_completions
}
_reset1_first_tab() {
  reset1-completions || return
  zle expand-or-complete
}
if (( ! $+functions[compdef] )); then
  zle -N reset1-first-tab _reset1_first_tab
  bindkey -M emacs '^I' reset1-first-tab
  bindkey -M viins '^I' reset1-first-tab
fi

# Load nvm once, on the first nvm/node/npm/npx/corepack command.
# No directory-change hook and no automatic .nvmrc scan on every prompt.
if [[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ]] && (( ! $+functions[nvm] )); then
  _reset1_load_nvm() {
    local requested="$1"
    shift
    unfunction nvm node npm npx corepack
    source "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" --no-use || return
    typeset -g _reset1_nvm_loaded=1
    _reset1_nvm_completions
    if [[ "$requested" == nvm ]]; then
      # Keep Node usable after e.g. `nvm --version`, but allow `nvm install`
      # even when this machine has no installed default yet.
      nvm use --silent default >/dev/null 2>&1
      nvm "$@"
    else
      nvm use --silent default >/dev/null || {
        print -u2 'No default Node available. Run: nvm install 26 && nvm alias default 26'
        return 1
      }
      command "$requested" "$@"
    fi
  }
  nvm() { _reset1_load_nvm nvm "$@"; }
  node() { _reset1_load_nvm node "$@"; }
  npm() { _reset1_load_nvm npm "$@"; }
  npx() { _reset1_load_nvm npx "$@"; }
  corepack() { _reset1_load_nvm corepack "$@"; }
fi
:
